messages:
Nate (Eng): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands security segment — prospect asked: can Redwood produce auditor-friendly evidence that audit logs are tamper-evident and show key rotations for Private deployments?

Kendra (Security): Yes. We can supply an evidence bundle containing batch chain-hashes (tamper-evidence), rotation-event records (who/when), and KMS interaction logs. For BYOK we record key ARNs/grants and signing call metadata; we do NOT retain plaintext key material.

Will (Product): Product note: "Create evidence bundle" will be a self-serve option in Console next quarter (beta). Bundles export to customer S3 or a secure temp URL. We'll include redaction toggles for PII.

Ivy (Privacy): Important: retention >12 months and exported bundles with PII may trigger region-specific privacy reviews (EU/UK/CN). DSAR/redaction workflow will be required and documented.

Nate (Eng): Any short CLI examples for S3 export or bundle creation?

Kendra (Security): Two quick snippets:
```
# enable export to customer S3 (Private)
redwoodctl logs export enable --dep dp-555 --target s3://cust-audit --encrypt --kms arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd
# create evidence bundle for date range
redwoodctl audit bundle create --deployment dp-555 --start 2024-01-01 --end 2024-12-31 --include-rotations --output s3://cust-evidence
```
Make sure VPC endpoints and IAM grants are configured first. Full flags in docs.

Will (Product): Actions: Kendra to publish evidence-bundle spec + CLI examples, Ivy to draft DSAR guidance, ops-bot to open a ticket for docs.

ops-bot: Ticket created: #TICKET-9999 "allhands-evidence-bundle-followup" assigned to Kendra (Security) due 2025-05-01.

Kendra (Security): Thanks everyone — ping me if you want to review the spec draft or BYOK diagrams. :thumbsup:
